name: g5c security suite
note: Each case names a security requirement, the specification it comes from and the ctest cases that prove it. `scas` is the test case name of the GSMA NESAS / 3GPP SCAS documents: TS 33.117 and the SCAS documents are not pinned in this repository, so those entries name the document and not a clause, and the SCAS column stays empty until they are pinned; nothing is named from memory.

cases.title: 5G-AKA vectors and the key hierarchy
cases.evidence: Milenage, KAUSF / KSEAF / KAMF / KgNB / NAS key derivation and RES* / HXRES* against the published test vectors

cases.title: EAP-AKA' authentication
cases.evidence: RFC 9048 vectors; the AUSF runs EAP-AKA' against a scripted UE with independently derived keys

cases.title: NAS integrity, ciphering, replay and wrong-MAC handling
cases.evidence: NIA2 / NEA2 vectors; the AMF drops a replayed count, a wrong MAC and an unprotected message after the security context exists

cases.title: NAS and NGAP decoders survive hostile input
cases.clause: decoders (robustness; see TS 33.117 for the product requirement)
cases.evidence: golden PDUs byte for byte; fuzz seeds replayed under ASan / UBSan

cases.title: SUCI concealment (Profile A and B) and de-concealment
cases.evidence: the Annex C vectors; the UDM resolves a concealed SUCI, refuses a tampered one and an unknown key id

cases.title: No subscriber identity in clear on N1 / N2; the null scheme can be refused; GUTI reallocation
cases.evidence: a concealing UE leaves no digits on N2 (and a null-scheme UE does, as the control); suci.null_scheme: reject; a fresh 5G-GUTI at every registration; g5c-privacy reads captures

cases.title: Mutual TLS between all network functions, certificates renewed live
cases.evidence: a client without a certificate, with a foreign CA's certificate, and cleartext to a TLS port are refused; renewal by SIGHUP without a restart

cases.title: Client certificate pinning and revocation
cases.evidence: sbi.tls.allowed_peers and sbi.tls.crl enforced in the live cluster

cases.title: OAuth2 access tokens between network functions
cases.evidence: no token, expired, forged key id, another audience and wrong NF type are all refused; the second of expiry

cases.title: Overload and rate control protect against signalling floods
cases.evidence: 429 with Retry-After and 3gpp-Sbi-Oci, clients that back off; 22,535 registrations in 4 s, 100 admitted, the AMF ready throughout

cases.title: Administration with roles and tenants
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: read / provision / policy / key-admin; a tenant cannot see that another tenant's subscriber exists; revocation without a restart

cases.title: Audit trail and security event streaming
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: audit lines name the caller; warnings, errors and audit lines go to a syslog / HTTP collector with X.733 fields

cases.title: Secrets are never written to logs, state or bundles
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: K and OPc looked for in logs and state after traffic; the support bundle redacts identities, keys and tokens

cases.title: TLS session secrets are exported only on request
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: G5C_TLS_KEYLOG decrypts a capture; without it the capture is opaque

cases.title: Invalid configuration is refused; a live change is validated and undone on harm
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: unknown keys and out-of-range values refused at start and at reload; a section that fails or a function that suffers is rolled back

cases.title: Parsers of every interface survive hostile input
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: fuzz seeds replayed under ASan / UBSan on every build; coverage-guided fuzzing needs clang (CI)

cases.title: Licences of the dependencies are audited
cases.clause: the clause is to be confirmed against the document
cases.evidence: SBOM and licence audit on every release; counsel's sign-off is outstanding
